promotion_rule: No QED by analogy, numerical evidence, shared notation, or structural resemblance. Every problem-specific bridge must be proved independently.

claims.title: Universal Relational-Zero Axiom
claims.statement: A zero of an admitted observable is realized only as vanishing relational distinction in its defining canonical relation.
claims.note: Explicit non-derived premise. Not silently promoted to a theorem.

claims.title: Relational-Zero Decomposition Principle
claims.statement: Different Millennium-problem obligations can be typed as distinct properties of a distinguished relational zero.
claims.note: Classification principle; does not assert equivalence of the problems.

claims.title: RH from A0
claims.statement: A0 implies that every non-trivial zero of the completed zeta function lies on Re(s)=1/2.
claims.source_status: Worked reference case with three complementary proof certificates.

claims.title: Relational Multiplicity-Index Transfer and Excess Theorem
claims.statement: For a holomorphic square matrix family A(z) with det A not identically zero, ord_0 det A(z) >= dim ker A(0). Equality holds iff the induced crossing map ker A(0) -> coker A(0) from A'(0) is an isomorphism.
claims.note: Finite-dimensional theorem proved by block decomposition and Schur complement. Defines nonnegative excess epsilon(A)=ord det A-dim ker.

claims.title: Bockstein-crossing identity for two-term perfect complexes
claims.statement: For a two-term perfect complex K[[T]]^n -> K[[T]]^n represented by A(T), the augmentation Bockstein is induced by q A'(0)|ker A(0), and epsilon(C)=ord_T det A(T)-dim H^1(C_0) is nonnegative; epsilon(C)=0 iff the Bockstein is an isomorphism.
claims.note: Exact local-algebra crosswalk and nonnegative multiplicity-excess theorem.

claims.title: Relative determinant trivialization valuation
claims.statement: For an invertible rank-one module Delta over a one-dimensional local domain R and nonzero meromorphic sections s1=q s2, ord_I(s1)-ord_I(s2)=ord_I(q). Equality of section orders is equivalent to q being an R-unit.
claims.note: Abstract determinant-line algebra; independent of BSD.

claims.title: Selmer determinant as canonical BSD carrier
claims.statement: Under the standard hypotheses of Nekovar-style Selmer-complex/Stark-system formalisms, the determinant line of the Selmer complex is a canonical arithmetic rank-one carrier; recent 2026 work proves a canonical isomorphism between the determinant of a Selmer complex and the corresponding Stark-system module.
claims.note: Carrier existence does not identify the complex L-germ with the arithmetic section and does not prove BSD.

claims.title: BSD B3 as Bockstein/height nondegeneracy
claims.statement: Under the standard self-dual Selmer-complex hypotheses identifying the cyclotomic Bockstein with the p-adic height construction, RZDP gate B3 is the nondegeneracy of the corresponding Bockstein/height regulator.
claims.note: This identifies the arithmetic meaning of B3; it does not assert universal regulator nondegeneracy.

claims.title: BSD analytic index triad
claims.statement: For L_E(z)=L(E,1+z), ord_0(L_E) equals both the winding number of L_E around zero on a sufficiently small contour and the local-algebra length of C{z}/(L_E).
claims.note: Standard argument principle plus local factorization L_E(z)=z^r u(z), u(0) != 0.

claims.title: BSD arithmetic exterior-degree index
claims.statement: rank_Z E(Q) equals dim_Q(E(Q) tensor Q), which equals the largest k with exterior power Lambda^k(E(Q) tensor Q) nonzero.
claims.note: Mordell-Weil finite generation plus finite-dimensional linear algebra.

claims.title: BSD analytic/Selmer parity seam
claims.statement: For elliptic curves over Q, the analytic rank and p-infinity Selmer rank have the same parity for every prime p.
claims.note: Closes only the mod-2 shadow; it is not the BSD integer equality.

claims.title: BSD Selmer/Sha obstruction decomposition
claims.statement: For every prime p, if r_p is the p-infinity Selmer corank and s_p the p-primary Sha corank, then r_p=r_MW+s_p. Combined with p-parity, k_p=(r_an-r_p)/2 is an integer and the BSD defect satisfies r_an-r_MW=2 k_p+s_p.
claims.note: Exact decomposition. No sign is asserted for k_p, so the identity does not separately force k_p=s_p=0.

claims.title: BSD nonnegative two-obstruction bridge
claims.statement: After verified analytic/determinant registration and Selmer specialization, the BSD rank defect decomposes as epsilon_{E,p}+s_p, where epsilon_{E,p}=r_an-r_p>=0 is the Bockstein multiplicity excess and s_p=corank Sha[p^infty]>=0. BSD rank equality is then equivalent to epsilon_{E,p}=0 and s_p=0.
claims.firewall: The nonnegative decomposition is conditional on the global analytic/determinant and specialization registrations. These cannot be inferred from the local multiplicity theorem.

operator_criterion.B2: ker A_E(0) canonically isomorphic to E(Q) tensor C
operator_criterion.B3: crossing map ker A_E(0) -> coker A_E(0) is an isomorphism

claims.note: Local algebra closes the sign problem once D2/D3/D5 are established: epsilon=r_an-r_p=2k_p is then an even nonnegative integer.

search_gates.D1: determinant/Selmer carrier and arithmetic Stark-system realization
search_gates.D3: analytic section -> Selmer determinant section up to controlled unit
search_gates.D4: Bockstein excess epsilon>=0; epsilon=0 iff nondegenerate crossing
search_gates.D5: specialization/control identifying H1 with Selmer corank
search_gates.D6: Sha-divisible control s_p=0 or a direct proof that total defect vanishes

claims.title: Yang-Mills spectral-gap bridge
claims.statement: Derive a positive continuum physical mass gap from a rigorously controlled gauge-sector construction.
claims.firewall: Unique vacuum/zero mode alone is insufficient.

claims.title: Hodge algebraic-realization bridge
claims.statement: Prove that the Hodge-class obstruction quotient vanishes by genuine algebraic-cycle realization.
claims.firewall: Do not define the defect using the desired cycle-span equality and call that a proof.

claims.title: Navier-Stokes dynamical-avoidance bridge
claims.statement: Construct a non-circular barrier/control quantity that stays positive and excludes finite-time singularity.
claims.firewall: The control estimate must not presuppose the target regularity.

claims.title: P versus NP resource-separation bridge
claims.statement: Construct a composition-stable invariant forcing super-polynomial resources for an NP-complete family.
